learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the basic rules of professional correspondence in the workplace and how to prepare these correspondences in appropriate formats.
Students learn to effectively use the terminology in technical report writing.
Students can prepare professional presentations and learn to improve their presentation skills.
Students learn to use appropriate English terms in job interviews and professional dialogues.
Students learn to evaluate technical reports and presentations and make suggestions for improvement.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and course presentation; emphasizing the importance of professional correspondence and presentations in business life.
Basic formats of professional correspondence and frequently used expressions in English.
Email writing and technical correspondence rules.
Structure of technical reports, headings, subheadings, and paragraph organization.
Writing introduction and conclusion sections in technical reports, with practical demonstrations.
How to use graphics and tables in technical reports and how to explain visual materials.
Presentation preparation techniques, language, and structure to be used in presentations.
Presentation preparation techniques, language, and structure to be used in presentations.
Presentation preparation techniques, language, and structure to be used in presentations.
Preparing presentations on technical topics and organizing slides.
Practical work aimed at improving presentation skills.
Using appropriate terminology for job interviews and professional dialogues.
Evaluation of technical reports and presentation projects, and feedback provision.
General review and evaluation of students' questions.
bibliography: Technical Writing and Professional Communication for Nonnative Speakers of English by Thomas N. Huckin, Leslie A. Olsen
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
